title: Can a 360° Camera Measure Its Own Scale?
subtitle: Metric Scale for Insta360 Reconstructions from the Camera's Embedded IMU, Validated Against a Co-Mounted LiDAR
description: The 1 kHz IMU inside an Insta360 X5 gives our 360° reconstructions metric scale to 0.81% against a co-mounted LiDAR, 2.4× closer than the phone it replaced. On the way we found that the textbook visual-inertial alignment, solved over a whole survey, overestimates scale by 3.4% with a consistent sign; solving each contiguous run on its own and averaging removes the bias. On fifty production surveys (33 km) the public estimator ran unattended, passed its own checks every time and agreed with the phone to σ = 2.3%.
author: OVER Research
